note: Limits are data, not design: the PM edits this file; every day's report records the version used. fund-2 adds correlation, liquidity and data-quality limits (v4, Nov 2026).

correlation.note: Signed by side: two longs in one cluster are one bet; a long and a short in a pair are a hedge.

liquidity.closing_auction_share: NOT ASSESSED: no closing-auction volume in free data (rule of thumb: stay under 20% of the auction)
liquidity.order_book_depth: NOT ASSESSED: no L2/L3 order-book or options-market data
